title: NoiseFingerprint and AlignmentScopeData — spectral noise display, correlation data
description:
Implement Source/Analysis/NoiseFingerprint and Source/Analysis/AlignmentScopeData as analysis-side display models for Diagnose/Align views (spec §20.2–20.3).

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §20.2 DI Alignment Scope (key onset, main onset, correlation curve, offset, confidence, offset variation, required key delay / main lookahead)
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §20.3 Noise Fingerprint (time-averaged frequency display: floor median, upper percentile, 50/60 Hz hum, harmonic mains, HF hiss, intermittent bursts, detector filter response, multiband thresholds)
- Source/Analysis/AnalysisFifo.h QualityMode and any noise/alignment fields on AnalysisFrame from h.1
- Existing Noise Learn / AlignmentAnalyzer public outputs if present under Source/DSP (consume snapshots; do not reimplement learning or cross-correlation engines)

Implement NoiseFingerprint.h/.cpp:
- Fixed-bin magnitude/spectral display buffer (prepare sets numBins; e.g. log or linear bins — document).
- updateFromLearnedProfile / accumulate or setSpectrum APIs ingest time-averaged idle-noise data already learned (median floor, upper percentile per bin if available).
- Accessors: getMagnitudes(), getNumBins(), optional peak markers for 50/60 Hz and harmonics flags.
- QualityMode Off freezes/clears updates;oth modes accept updates on message/analysis thread only.

Implement AlignmentScopeData.h/.cpp:
- Fixed-length waveform buffers for key onset and main onset windows; fixed correlation curve buffer; atomic/simple fields for selectedOffsetMs (or samples), confidence, offsetVariation, recommendedKeyDelay / mainLookahead.
- setOnsetWaveforms / setCorrelationCurve / setResult APIs copy into preallocated storage.
- Read APIs for GUI painting copyRecent-style without allocation.

Neither class runs on the audio thread. No PluginProcessor wiring. Do not edit AnalysisFifo or PerformanceHistory sources. Do not edit CMakeLists or tests.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: NoiseFingerprint exposes a fixed-bin time-averaged spectral magnitude buffer sized in prepare
NoiseFingerprint can ingest/update from a learned noise profile snapshot API
AlignmentScopeData stores key/main onset waveforms, correlation curve, offset, and confidence in fixed buffers
Both classes refuse heap allocation on steady-state update/read paths after prepare
QualityMode Off disables live updates for both units
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: reimplement Noise Learn or DI cross-correlation DSP engines
perform analysis work on the audio thread

allowed: choose fixed bin count (e.g. 64–256) and document linear vs log spacing
copy external learned-profile arrays into internal buffers rather than owning FFT
use atomics for scalar offset/confidence if a GUI timer races updates
depend on QualityMode declared in AnalysisFifo.h
forbidden: block audio thread waiting for spectrum or correlation
